findings.claim: Observed HZD stock profile is plain ASCII text with sixteen CRLF-terminated filename records, no header/count/parameters; retail advances via unchecked delimiter search and CRT mask0x103, while the independent reader is bounded.
findings.limitations: Only this retail build/corpus; CRLF/15-byte independent-reader policy is narrower than unsafe retail; locale and historical layouts unmeasured.

findings.claim: All 74 archive-authenticated HZD files have 224 bytes and sixteen 12-byte names, with 33 distinct payloads; 78 of 80 mission WRLD fields select 36 logical HZD names /19 payloads.
findings.limitations: Accessible installation only; installed mission files hashed but not archive-authenticated; no native load success.

findings.claim: Every one of 272 HZD texture names resolves in inventory:104 direct MAP PIX members,168 VQM PIX members with ZFS CBKs and M16 PIX members; runtime uses ordered primary/optional pointer pairs.
findings.limitations: Inventory and static boundary do not prove decoder success, active source selection, palette or rendering correctness.

findings.claim: HZD initialization releases the parsed manifest before texture acquisition, retains partial pairs on failure, and has no replacement rollback;00401510 is a separate pair-release loop despite its inherited load annotation.
findings.limitations: Normal bounded static paths only; malformed parser paths may not reach release; repeated intact teardown is a local property, not whole-engine lifecycle proof.
